info.name: Leave Types Management APIs
info.description:
Comprehensive Leave Types APIs including General Information, Usage & Eligibility Rules, Holidays & Carry Forward Rules, and Encashment Rules with Status Management (Draft, Published, Active, Inactive).

Base path: `/leave-types`

item.name: 1. Get All Leave Types (List with Filters & Pagination)

query.description: Search by name, code (e.g. 'CL'), or description

request.description: Returns list of leave types with their current status, balance tracking toggle, rules, and 'usedInPoliciesCount' (how many policies currently use this leave type).

item.name: 2. Get Single Leave Type by ID

request.description: Fetches complete details for a single leave type including its 3 sub-rule tabs: eligibility, holidaysCarryForward, and encashment, along with usedInPoliciesCount.

request.description: Saves a Leave Type in 'Draft' status so it can be edited later before publishing.

item.name: 5. Update Leave Type (Save Changes / Edit All Tabs)

request.description: Updates main leave type properties and upserts/updates any of the 3 sub-rule tables. NOTE: Once a leave type is 'Published', modifications are locked and this will return a 400 Bad Request error.
Quick status update endpoint. Allowed status values: 'Active', 'Inactive', 'Draft', 'Published'.

query.description: Pass true to force delete even if used in policies

request.description: Soft deletes the leave type. Will block deletion with a warning if the leave type is in use by policies unless ?force=true is passed.
